findings_and_limits.observation: The hardcoded required-file list omits files consumed/referenced by its own runbook/package commands: rls-access-governance.test.ts, validate-backup-restore.test.mjs, benchmarks/k6/parse-results.js, the expected performance-report.json input, and check-migration-source-of-truth.mjs. The performance report is absent in the current worktree. The validator still returns PASS for 20 paths.

Required package scripts are checked only for string type. Replacing an entry with an empty or unrelated command would still satisfy this validator. Current command strings look aligned by static inspection, but there is no assertion tying them to the required runner files or runbook commands.

The checker uses existsSync for file entries and does not require regular files, reject symlinks, or record hashes/head. It is not candidate-bound. The runbook accurately prevents treating this local PASS as target proof.

candidate_actions: Keep the runbook status as preparation/BLOCKED until REM-021, exact authority and approved target exist; do not execute its DB/process/benchmark commands in this round.
Derive required files from the actual script/runbook dependencies, include the omitted fixture/tests/parsers, and validate nonempty command semantics rather than only key presence.
If this PASS is attached as evidence, label it local preparation and bind it to a candidate only after a clean candidate and hashes exist.
limitations: The target-pack test/CLI do not execute any required target runner.
